#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

// Forward declaration of FFT class
class FFT;

vector<long long> expo(const vector<long long>& orig, long long pow);
static class FFT {
public:
    static const int maxk = 21;
    static const int maxn = (1 << maxk) + 1;
    static double wR[maxn], wI[maxn], rR[maxn], rI[maxn], aR[maxn], aI[maxn];
    static int n, k, lastk, dp[maxn];

    static void fft(bool inv);
    static vector<long long> multiply(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b);
    static void fft2(vector<vector<double>>& xr, vector<vector<double>>& xi, bool inv);
    static vector<vector<long long>> multiply2(const vector<vector<long long>>& a, const vector<vector<long long>>& b);
    static vector<long long> multiplyPrecise(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b);
    static vector<long long> fftOr(const vector<long long>& arr, int n, bool invert);
    static vector<long long> fftXor(const vector<long long>& arr, int n, bool invert);
};

double FFT::wR[FFT::maxn], FFT::wI[FFT::maxn], FFT::rR[FFT::maxn], FFT::rI[FFT::maxn], FFT::aR[FFT::maxn], FFT::aI[FFT::maxn];
int FFT::n, FFT::k, FFT::lastk = -1, FFT::dp[FFT::maxn];

void FFT::fft(bool inv) {
    if (lastk != k) {
        lastk = k;  dp[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1, g = -1; i < n; i++) {
            if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0) g++;
            dp[i] = dp[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (k - 1 - g));
        }
        wR[1] = 1;
        wI[1] = 0;
        for (int t = 0; t < k - 1; t++) {
            double a = M_PI / n * (1 << (k - 1 - t));
            double curR = cos(a), curI = sin(a);
            int p2 = (1 << t), p3 = p2 * 2;
            for (int j = p2, kk = j * 2; j < p3; j++, kk += 2) {
                wR[kk] = wR[j];
                wI[kk] = wI[j];
                wR[kk + 1] = wR[j] * curR - wI[j] * curI;
                wI[kk + 1] = wR[j] * curI + wI[j] * curR;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int d = dp[i];
        if (i < d) {
            double tmp = aR[i];
            aR[i] = aR[d];
            aR[d] = tmp;
            tmp = aI[i];
            aI[i] = aI[d];
            aI[d] = tmp;
        }
    }
    if (inv) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) aI[i] = -aI[i];
    for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            int wit = len;
            for (int it = 0, j = i + len; it < len; it++, i++, j++) {
                double tmpR = aR[j] * wR[wit] - aI[j] * wI[wit];
                double tmpI = aR[j] * wI[wit] + aI[j] * wR[wit];
                wit++;
                aR[j] = aR[i] - tmpR;
                aI[j] = aI[i] - tmpI;
                aR[i] += tmpR;
                aI[i] += tmpI;
            }
        }
    }
}

vector<long long> FFT::multiply(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
    int na = a.size(), nb = b.size();
    n = 1; k = 0;
    while (n < na + nb - 1) { n <<= 1; k++; }
    vector<long long> A(a), B(b);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        aR[i] = i < na ? A[i] : 0;
        aI[i] = i < nb ? B[i] : 0;
    }
    fft(false);
    aR[n] = aR[0];
    aI[n] = aI[0];
    double q = -1.0 / n / 4.0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= (n - i); ++i) {
        double tmpR = aR[i] * aR[i] - aI[i] * aI[i];
        double tmpI = aR[i] * aI[i] * 2;
        tmpR -= aR[n - i] * aR[n - i] - aI[n - i] * aI[n - i];
        tmpI -= aR[n - i] * aI[n - i] * -2;
        aR[i] = -tmpI * q;
        aI[i] = tmpR * q;
        aR[n - i] = aR[i];
        aI[n - i] = -aI[i];
    }
    fft(true);
    vector<long long> ans(na + nb - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)ans.size(); i++) ans[i] = (long long)(round(aR[i])) % MOD;
    return ans;
}

vector<vector<long long>> FFT::multiply2(const vector<vector<long long>>& a, const vector<vector<long long>>& b) {
    int n1 = 1, n2 = 1;
    while (n1 < (int)a.size() + (int)b.size() - 1) n1 <<= 1;
    while (n2 < (int)a[0].size() + (int)b[0].size() -1) n2 <<= 1;
    vector<vector<double>> ar(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0)), ai(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0));
    vector<vector<double>> br(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0)), bi(n1, vector<double>(n2, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)a[0].size(); ++j)
            ar[i][j] = a[i][j];
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)b[0].size(); ++j)
            br[i][j] = b[i][j];
    fft2(ar, ai, false);
    fft2(br, bi, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < n1; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n2; ++j) {
            double r1 = ar[i][j], r2 = br[i][j];
            double i1 = ai[i][j], i2 = bi[i][j];
            double real = r1 * r2 - i1 * i2;
            ai[i][j] = i1 * r2 + i2 * r1;
            ar[i][j] = real;
        }
    fft2(ar, ai, true);
    vector<vector<long long>> result(a.size() + b.size() - 1, vector<long long>(a[0].size() + b[0].size() -1));
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)result.size(); ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)result[0].size(); ++j)
            result[i][j] = (long long)(round(ar[i][j]));
    return result;
}

void FFT::fft2(vector<vector<double>>& xr, vector<vector<double>>& xi, bool inv) {
    n = xr[0].size();
    k = __builtin_ctz(n);
    int m = xr.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            aR[j] = xr[i][j];
            aI[j] = xi[i][j];
        }
    fft(inv);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            xr[i][j] = aR[j] / (inv ? n : 1);
            xi[i][j] = aI[j] / (inv ? -n : 1);
        }
    // Repeat for columns
    n = xr.size();
    k = __builtin_ctz(n);
    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)xr.size(); ++i) {
            aR[i] = xr[i][j];
            aI[i] = xi[i][j];
        }
    fft(inv);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)xr.size(); ++j) {
            xr[j][j] = aR[j] / (inv ? n : 1);
            xi[j][j] = aI[j] / (inv ? -n : 1);
        }
}

vector<long long> FFT::multiplyPrecise(const vector<long long>& a, const vector<long long>& b) {
    long long k = (long long)(sqrt((double)MOD));
    vector<long long> a1(a.size()), a2(a.size()), b1(b.size()), b2(b.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); ++i) {
        a1[i] = a[i] % k;
        a2[i] = a[i] / k;
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < b.size(); ++i) {
        b1[i] = b[i] % k;
        b2[i] = b[i] / k;
    }
    vector<long long> r11 = multiply(a1, b1);
    vector<long long> r12 = multiply(a1, b2);
    vector<long long> r21 = multiply(a2, b1);
    vector<long long> r22 = multiply(a2, b2);
    vector<long long> res(r11.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < res.size(); ++i)
        res[i] = (k * k * r22[i] + k * (r12[i] + r21[i]) + r11[i]) % MOD;
    return res;
}

vector<long long> FFT::fftOr(const vector<long long>& arr, int n, bool invert) {
    vector<long long> ans(arr);
    for (int b = 1; b < n; b <<= 1)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if ((i & b) != 0) continue;
            ans[i + b] += invert ? -ans[i] : ans[i];
        }
    return ans;
}

vector<long long> FFT::fftXor(const vector<long long>& arr, int n, bool invert) {
    vector<long long> ans(arr);
    for (int b = 1; b < n; b <<= 1)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if ((i & b) != 0) continue;
            long long u = ans[i], v = ans[i + b];
            ans[i] = u + v; ans[i + b] = u - v;
        }
    if (invert) for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans[i] /= n;
    return ans;
}

vector<long long> expo(const vector<long long>& orig, long long pow) {
    if (pow == 1) return orig;
    if ((pow & 1) != 0)
        return FFT::multiplyPrecise(orig, expo(orig, pow - 1));
    vector<long long> tmp = expo(orig, pow >> 1);
    return FFT::multiplyPrecise(tmp, tmp);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<long long> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int val;
        cin >> val;
        base[val] = 1;
    }
    vector<long long> res = expo(base, n >> 1);
    long long tot = 0;
    for (auto e : res) {
        tot = (tot + (e * e) % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    cout << tot << "\n";
    return 0;
}
